sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r7/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 29 (global_browser_gate_is_present_and_correct_in_every_dimension); Internal Quality Checks row 29 ('hard-zeros blank/static-shell/cross-origin apps'); Deterministic Checks check-rubric-prompt.py row (read via openpyxl read_only, in memory)
qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (gates must exclude convincing dead apps; tool feasibility; runtime evidence)
evidence: Real gate in gate dimensions: scoring.toml [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; score.py:41 gates_passed = all(scores[k] > floor) and :48 reward 0 unless gates pass (score.py byte-identical to template). gates/render/judge.toml hro_gate_render (all_pass, binary): wrong password leaves visitor signed out, correct Recruiter password then shows a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content; 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient' (auth leg with positive control). gates/constraints/judge.toml hro_gate_shared (all_pass, binary): Recruiter creates a job (title, team, hiring manager, 2 places) and a candidate (name, email, source) through ordinary UI; Observer in 'a new independent empty browser context' finds the same job and exactly one card in Applied; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate' (server-backing leg). Team/source/places/Observer-reads-all are public: hireops_rules.md:18,27-31. In-dimension gate restated in every scored prompt: scored/functional/prompt.md:9-13 ('## Global browser gate and independent scoring'; 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0' - all 43 functional criteria are type=binary); scored/polish/prompt.md:9-12 ('gives binary0 throughout' - all 5 binary); scored/visual/prompt.md:9-12 ('gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero' - 5 likert points=5). Each scored gate includes sign-in (auth) and a create + independent-context Observer readback (backing), and none assigns partial credit on gate failure (quality-checks.md:125 defect absent). The scored gates are a subset of the constraints gate (no team/source/'exactly one'), so no conforming app passing the real gate is zeroed by a stricter in-dimension gate. Same-origin: grep for 'origin' across all five prompt.md and judge.toml files finds nothing; the template's 'Replays use an in-page call from the app's own origin' line is not present; functional prompt.md:17 allows 'page.evaluate fetch or context request'. Gates do not forbid CDN/off-origin assets; instruction.md:13 explicitly allows browser CDN use. Consistent with SKILL.md Delivery profile and staged-task-contract.md:156. The Internal sheet's 'cross-origin apps' wording conflicts with the public row/skill; recorded here and resolved in favour of the row text + skill delivery profile (public network). Adversarial probes (by source reasoning): (a) localStorage-only app that renders a board and fakes saves -> fails because the Observer readback is in a fresh browser context (constraints prompt.md:9; scored gates line 11). (b) static shell / health-only server -> fails render gate ('only a health response is insufficient') and in-dimension gate. (c) app with working sign-in but job creation only, no candidates -> 'job-only app does not satisfy the gate'. (d) conforming app using a different route layout, labels, or CDN assets -> gates say discover by intent (prompt line 1, app_context.md:33-34) and impose no route/origin requirement, so it should pass. No counterexample found at source level. Unmeasured runtime: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; only a scripted golden Playwright/API driver exists. Therefore no configured judge has executed any gate on the golden or on a weak app. Additionally, every gate's independent-context step names the tool browser_run_code_unsafe; I could not verify that @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 (tests/Dockerfile) exposes that exact tool name (no local install; no Docker run per assignment). The prompts provide a fallback ('A supported separate-context tool is an alternative'), but if neither exists the gate degrades to 'NOT EXERCISED -> binary0', which would zero the golden in every dimension. This is a tool-feasibility/runtime gap, not a demonstrated defect.
notes: Risk=true solely because the gates have not been executed by the configured claude-code judge (no full verifier run in raw-evidence-index) and the exact Playwright MCP tool name used for the independent context (browser_run_code_unsafe) is unverified for @playwright/mcp@0.0.79. Owner should confirm via a configured gate run that the golden passes both gate dimensions and every in-dimension gate, and that a localStorage-only/static weak app is zeroed.
